method: Conservative independent reconciliation of the two complete 500-root reviews. Exact equality of root, zero-based English meaning, source record hash, English frame and subject profile is mandatory; only intersection of aspect modes is retained. This is a selected lexical registry, not verification of all missing children or complete runtime translation coverage. No synonym merging, unilateral tense override, new English meaning or project-source edit.

guards.same-source-sense: Resolve the exact candidate English meaningIndex and recordSha256. Do not use another meaning of the same spelling or reuse another frame context.
guards.explicit-form-grammar: Every actual Spanish word/form still needs independently explicit same-source root, person, number, mood, tense, voice and construction evidence; candidate missingChildren lists are not approval lists.
guards.nonpronominal-only: This registry authorizes nonpronominal selected readings only. Do not strip se, infer clitics, or silently discard source reflexive/object/construction metadata. If a root permits both transitive and pronominal uses, only the selected nonpronominal sense with independently compatible grammar is approved.
guards.preserve-context: Both reviewers’ context and usage notes must remain available per selected reading, including rare/obsolete/regional, subject-type, literal/figurative and source-metadata disagreements. Never reinterpret an animal/physical/technical predicate as an unrestricted human action or the reverse.
guards.no-invented-arguments: Do not invent missing objects, recipients, destinations or following infinitives to make a clause complete. Ordinary selected trailing-complement or transitive omissions may be labelled elliptical dictionary fragments; they are not complete authored example sentences. Source-explicit lexical content such as lay eggs is allowed, not a made-up puzzle event.
guards.intersected-aspect-only: Use exactly the intersected aspectModes. Empty means no supported imperfect state/progressive rendering, not permission to guess habitual used to. Other source-proven tenses remain subject to the normal renderer guards.
guards.pinned-agid-only: Use only unqualified known English inflections from the recorded pinned AGID hash and the closed BE paradigm. No unilateral optional past/participle overrides are carried into this registry; sense-qualified heads were withheld entirely.
guards.it-only: Allow only the specifically approved singular third-person it reading; exclude personal subjects and unsupported imperatives. Preserve its stimulus/experiencer context.
